# ClientFilter

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The client connected to a remote desktop session, for per-client
scoping on multi-session hosts. Each list that is set must match.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/sessions/client`, `/policy/scope/sessions/client`, `/policy/unknown/scope_groups/all_of/sessions/client`, `/policy/unknown/scopes/sessions/client`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/sessions/client`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device_sets` | array of [`LibraryRef`](library-ref.md) | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Device sets (#37) the client device is in. |
| `hostname` | array of string | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Wildcards on the client's host name. |
| `ip` | array of string | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Address blocks (`10.0.0.0/8`) or ranges (`10.0.0.1-10.0.0.9`) for the client's address. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
